about: Hand labels for the website with the real Gemini Nano (Chrome 155 on the owner's PC), before it could look things up: chatcomputer.ai as deployed at e5559ea, 20 Oct 2026 (run web-nano-real-base: 87 cases, the 10 internet ones first). Read from each answer and what opened, by the same meaning as scripted-baseline.json. Answers the page wrote itself are labelled as in scripted-v2.json (the same answers); Gemini's are labelled here, with a note.

recipe.note: Refuses: can't look up recipes online.

capital.note: Refuses to say Canberra: 'not able to look up information on the internet'.

explain-quantum.note: A good plain explanation (qubits), in the reply.

write-email.note: A usable draft, in the reply (the page put on the screen is nearly empty).

poem.note: A four-line poem about the sea, in the reply.

translate.note: Arigatou gozaimasu, though the sentence around it is in Japanese.

trip-plan.note: 'I am Gemma... not able to plan a trip'.

advice.note: Won't give sleep tips: 'consult a doctor'.

code.note: 'I am Gemma... don't have the capability'; no function.

gibberish.note: Asks what they'd like, without saying what it can do.

haze-trace.note: Says three times that it isn't connected to the internet; 'the haze?' gets no answer.

pm.note: Refuses: it can't look things up, so doesn't know.

look-it-up.note: Refuses twice, though it knows (Moshe Safdie).

search-population.note: The written answers searched the demo's files instead.

headlines.note: No news: a link to BBC News.

news-yesterday.note: Refuses: not connected to the internet.

why-no-internet.note: 'I am not connected to the internet'.

tell-me-more.note: 'I am Gemma... no information'; the follow-up ('the worst one') taken for rudeness.
